checks: actual first-run setup: masked confirmation, mismatch blocks setup, key creation and no password in browser storage

held background job: poll and import refresh preserve unchanged image DOM/focus, open zoom, and expanded OCR body while another row updates
after the last job, a focused stale row stays stable and refreshes from saved state on blur without another poll
filter eviction, including an empty result set, defers replacing active zoom or expanded OCR until interaction is released
correction persists and the result screen links directly to actual generic CSV download
fallback download produces a real encrypted backup that restores successfully

375px results keep horizontal scrolling within the result table
line_ending_scope: Observed source hashes are the exact bytes run locally. Git text files are normalized to LF for distribution; canonical mapping is added after staging preparation. No logic changes are made by this normalization.
canonical_hashing: Git text blob SHA-256 per .gitattributes; local observed hashes remain exact raw run bytes.
